annotations.annotation_text: Opening stage direction of Episode 15 (Circe). 12:00 AM (Midnight). Dublin's red-light district (Nighttown / Monto), centered around Tyrone and Mabbot Streets. Structured entirely as an expressionist theatrical playscript where psychological repressions, hallucinations, and guilt figures materialize physically.
sources: Gilbert, Stuart. James Joyce's Ulysses: A Study. Faber, 1930.
Gifford, Don, and Robert J. Seidman. Ulysses Annotated. UC Press, 1988, p. 450.

annotations.annotation_text: Joyce's term for the Monto brothel quarter of Dublin, at the time the largest red-light district in the British Isles. Corresponds to Circe's island of Aeaea where men are transformed into swine.
sources: Finegan, John. The Story of Monto. Mercier Press, 1978.
Ellmann, Richard. James Joyce. Oxford UP, 1982.
